quarterly_data.quarter: Huaqin Technology results briefing Q&A: Q1 2026 (05-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Qiu Wensheng (Q1 2026 results briefing): Q1 2026 revenue was RMB 407.5 hundred million, up 16.42% YoY, and net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 10.6 hundred million, up 25.96%; the three core businesses (mobile terminals, personal computers and data center) grew steadily YoY, while the three emerging businesses (automotive electronics, robotics and software) began to ramp.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue RMB 407.5 hundred million (+16.42% YoY); net profit RMB 10.6 hundred million (+25.96%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Huaqin Technology results briefing Q&A: Q1 2026 (05-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Qiu Wensheng (Q1 2026 results briefing): for full-year 2026 the company expects revenue and net profit to keep growing steadily, with revenue up more than 15% YoY and profit growth slightly higher than revenue growth. He said the gap between Q1 net profit and net profit excluding non-recurring items came mainly from investment and other income outside the core business.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 revenue growth > 15% YoY; profit growth slightly above revenue growth

quarterly_data.quarter: Huaqin Technology results briefing Q&A: Q1 2026 (05-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Qiu Wensheng (Q1 2026 results briefing): Huaqin's supernode achieved small-batch shipments in Q2 2026, will ramp gradually and enter volume shipments in H2, with full-year supernode revenue expected above RMB 100 hundred million and an industry-leading position. He said supernodes, a key new AI infrastructure investment for China's major cloud vendors and intelligent-computing centers, beat traditional GPU clusters on communication latency, compute density, cost efficiency, floor-space use and TCO; Huaqin is one of very few makers able to design both the compute node and the network node, and offers cooling from mainly-liquid to fully liquid-cooled, interconnect positioning software, dedicated production fixtures and racking processes, and high-power power shelves with supercapacitors. It co-develops, adapts and tests supernodes with customers ('mass-produce one generation, develop one, pre-research one') and aims for higher gross margin.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 supernode revenue expected > RMB 100 hundred million; small-batch shipments in Q2 2026, volume in H2
